# NYC RENT GUIDELINES BOARD — annual apartment/loft renewal guidelines. STAGE 1 OF THE TRANSMISSION CHAIN: this is the policy variable that sets rent growth on FLG's rent-regulated multifamily collateral.

# Source-authority: PRIMARY — each row pulled by FLG 2026-08-28 from that order's OWN page at rentguidelinesboard.cityofnewyork.us, verbatim "For a one-/two-year lease commencing..." text. NOT from the summary-chart PDF.

# ⚠️ WHY NOT THE PDF: the RGB "Apartment Orders #1-#58" summary chart was fetched and pdfminer returned it with COLUMNS SCRAMBLED — one-year and two-year figures interleaved so that order-to-value assignment was ambiguous. A run-rate built from it would have been a guess wearing a citation. Rows below come from per-order pages instead, where the sentence names the lease term and the date window explicitly. Pre-2022 rows are deliberately ABSENT rather than parsed from the chart.

# ⚠️ REGIME: HSTPA-2019 changed what these guidelines mean for collateral (vacancy decontrol and most vacancy allowances removed). Pre-2019 guidelines are NOT comparable and are not a base rate for the post-HSTPA world (finding_historical_fire_count_assumes_one_regime).
